The direct co-purchase neighbors significantly shaped the prediction; notably, products like the "Tyrannosaurus Rex Soft Plastic Dinosaur" and the "Schleich Brachiosaurus" are both clearly from the Toys & Games category, suggesting a pattern of association with similar dinosaur-themed toys. Looking beyond direct neighbors, 2-hop connections like "Realistic Triceratops" and "Spinosaurus" further echo the toy-centric theme, reinforcing the model's conclusion. The pattern of connections and feature influences collectively leads the model to associate the Schleich Giganotosaurus with the Toys & Games category, reflecting a broader network of related products that share both a thematic and categorical consistency.
